AniLife mobile preview — smoky neutral liquid glass + accurately aligned seek bar
Source feature commit: 6c131f7005899d63d33202cbb7acce51752cbf83
Visual polish to previous liquid-glass-native controls:
- PlayerLiquidGlass translucent dark neutral body instead of milky silver-gray fills, thinner reflective rim and minimal white highlights.
- PlayerControlsScaffold lighter full-width top/bottom scrims, preserving anime contrast while keeping glyphs legible.
- PlayerSeekBar visible track/knob nudged down by 10dp inline / 7dp landscape within the same full 48dp gesture target. Drag maths, trim markers and buffered progress are unchanged.
- New seek mapping regression test.
Do not alter native Media3 PlayerView/SurfaceView, Morphe AmbientLightMath, MorpheAmbientRenderer, VideoAmbientWash, audio/subtitle track handling, playback services, inline/fullscreen callbacks, required GPL credit, mobile-only manifest or package ID.
Run mobile unit tests, lint, universal APK assembly, verify debug signing, and publish preview APK only on successful verification. Preserve stable release. Real-device visual confirmation still necessary.
